integrity: Every finite simplicial collapse is supplied as an explicit operation and independently checked by a standalone exhaustive verifier. Integral homotopy follows from complete acyclic matchings, not extrapolation or field homology.
limitations: Specific Wagner graph M8 only; non-equivariant integral homotopy; rational dihedral characters, not integral homology lattice isomorphisms or equivariant homotopy equivalences. Unindexed equivalent prior literature cannot be ruled out.
title: The Wagner graph's complete induced-forest filtration and seven-dimensional dihedral homology
